title: DaeMoon save package manifest
description: manifest.json at the root of a save package (.zip, miniz). Read by core/src/manifest.c and server/internal/api.

format_version.description: Bumped only on an incompatible layout change. A client rejects anything it does not know.

title_id.description: 3ds/nx: 16 uppercase hex digits. nds: game code plus internal name, uppercase.

version.description: Server issued. Monotonically increasing per title. 0 means never uploaded.

parent_version.description: The version this package was derived from. null for a first upload.

sha256.description: Digest of the payload entries, not of the zip container. See docs/manifest.md.

size.description: Total uncompressed byte count of the payload entries.

device_label.description: User set. Shown in the conflict dialog. Never used for any decision.

created_at.description: ISO 8601. INFORMATIONAL ONLY. Never used for ordering: the console RTC is user settable.

entries.description: Payload entries in the order they are hashed. Paths are relative to the save root, forward slashes only.

title_name.description: What the console calls the game, in whatever script it uses. Optional and informational: everything is keyed by title_id, and a package written before consoles sent one has none.

secure_value.description: The console stored value the save was bound to when it was packed, for the 3DS titles that have one. Optional, and its absence is meaningful: zero is a legitimate value, so a package without the field leaves the console's own value alone on restore, while a package with it writes that value back. Absent on every other platform and from packages written before the field existed.
